notes.title: If the game doesn’t launch
notes.notes:
[p]Resolved a launch failure caused by a slight change in the game’s installation path introduced in Patch 1.0.5.
Please restart Steam if the issue persists. Apologies for the inconvenience.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes: [p]-（Spoiler alert）\[spoiler]  Fixed a bug where the branching condition for "High Difficulty Action" and the trigger for the preceding warning message were inconsistent.\[/spoiler][/p][p]- （Spoiler alert）\[spoiler] Fixed a bug where the forced battle near the end of Celestial Sea in the high-difficulty route could end earlier.\[/spoiler][/p]

notes.title: Demo Re-released
notes.notes:
The demo is now available again.
We’ll also be announcing the release date of the full version soon—stay tuned for updates!

notes.title: About the Demo Availability Period
notes.notes:
We plan to temporarily take down the demo around March 18 (please note that it will no longer be playable during this period).
The duration of the downtime is undecided, but we plan to make it available again in the future.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.4
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs, adjusted the game balance, and refined the level design.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.3
notes.notes:
-Removed the restriction preventing the game from transitioning to the title screen until the frame rate stabilized.
-Added the option to visualize current frame rate.

notes.title: Patch 0.9.2
notes.notes:
-Fixed a fatal bug that you encounter at Ja's House.
-Added the option to switch between fullscreen and windowed mode.

notes.title: Demo Version is Available Now!
notes.notes:
The demo version of "Bloom Thrice" is now available.
You can get it for free from here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3354900/Bloom_Thrice_Demo/

If you enjoyed it, please leave a review on it (even a few words)!

- Save data will be compatible with the full version.
- Streaming is fine. For more details, visit the website. https://www.bloomthrice.com/en

Thank you.
